note: Preview-vs-runtime parity per banking direction. All reads; zero journals.

lines.note: An approved rule is in force and states no VAT. This is an explicit zero, not missing configuration.

commission.runtimeDecision: NONE — the commitment service never invokes CommissionEngine
commission.note: No commission is evaluated or recorded on a wallet→bank transfer. The commitment binds fee and limit only; it never invokes the commission engine, so an authored commission rule for this product would be previewable but never applied or settled. No commission rule resolves for this product, currency and targeting either.

executionBlockers: A7_INBOUND_EXECUTION_AUTHORITY is bound to UnavailableA7InboundExecutionAuthority in production, so no bank credit can be posted until an approved execution authority is implemented and registered.
INBOUND_SUSPENSE_POLICY is deliberately unavailable: there is no approved accounting treatment for received funds that cannot be credited.

statutoryCharges.note: No statutory charge other than VAT on our own service fee is modelled. This direction charges no customer service fee, so there is no fee for VAT to attach to. No statutory charge applies to a bank credit.

commission.runtimeDecision: NONE — the inbound credit path runs no commission step
